biotools.summary: WHONET is a free Windows application developed by the WHO Collaborating Centre for Surveillance of Antimicrobial Resistance for managing and analyzing microbiology laboratory data, particularly focusing on antimicrobial resistance surveillance. It supports public health surveillance and outbreak detection through data management and analysis.
